lesson.text: Quick memory: how do you breathe to calm down? (Slowly, in and out.) Today: a calm toolbox and tricky moments with friends.
A calm toolbox is things that help you calm down: slow breaths, counting to ten, a short walk, talking to someone, drawing, calm music.
In a quarrel, calm down first, then say it calmly: 'I feel ... when ...'. Listen too, then find a fair way, like taking turns.
If someone is unkind: stay with the person, don't join in, and tell a grown-up you trust. Online: don't reply, keep it, block it, tell.
Telling a grown-up is not telling tales: it is getting help. Keep telling until someone helps.
Try it in the world: open the Calm Corner and fill your toolbox.
